title: 17th Street Market
why: The lowest blocks of Shockoe Bottom; the market where most of Gaston's water met, too.

title: Main Street Station
why: The station and its train shed standing in the water.

title: 17th and Dock, the canal's end
why: Where the Bottom spills to the river today (step 15); the wall's V and its Dock Street opening.

title: Shockoe Slip, 14th and Cary
why: The edge of the water at the foot of downtown.

title: Mayo Island
why: The island under the river, its buildings standing in it.

title: Tobacco Row and the Dock
why: The warehouses along Dock Street, the Dock between them and the river.

title: Great Shiplock Park
why: The canal's lock to the tidal river, at Rocketts.
